2025.positive_edge_outcome: Every ticket with modeled edge >= 0 missed for all three learned variants; ROI=0 in all predeclared positive-edge threshold policies.

audit_note: Payout join is not broken: winning quinella identity and return_yen_per100 are derived from the same canonical payout_map key. The zero returns in positive-edge selections reflect zero winning tickets, not missing payout data.
interpretation: A model that only slightly improves or matches race log loss can still create catastrophic false-positive edge by shifting tiny probability mass onto very high-odds tickets.
The 2025 positive-edge sets were dominated by extreme odds: e.g. MARKET_VALUE 0_5 band mean odds ~5590 and L175_VALUE 0_5 band mean odds ~5626, with zero realized hits.
Do not use naive edge = p*odds-1 from these blended probabilities as a buy rule.
Market-centered probability quality and betting-value calibration are separate problems.
